name: The Fool
upright: This card is all about new beginnings and trust in the unknown. Upright, it suggests curiosity, fresh starts, and the courage to take a leap. Where are you being invited to start fresh? Take one small step toward something that excites you.
reversed: This card reversed is all about hesitation or recklessness. It suggests ignoring red flags, acting carelessly, or fearing the unknown. Are you holding back because of fear, or rushing ahead without a plan? Slow down, check your footing, then move forward mindfully.

name: The Magician
upright: This card is all about personal power and focused intention. Upright, it suggests that you have the tools and talents to make things happen. How can you channel your skills into something meaningful right now? Pick one idea and take the first tangible step toward it today.
reversed: This card reversed is all about misused potential or scattered focus. It suggests manipulation, wasted talent, or lack of clear direction. Where might you be letting your power slip through your fingers? Regain clarity by choosing one priority and cutting the distractions.

name: The High Priestess
upright: This card is all about intuition, hidden knowledge, and inner wisdom. Upright, it suggests listening to your gut and trusting what you sense beneath the surface. What is your intuition whispering that you’ve been ignoring? Take quiet time alone to reconnect with your inner voice.
reversed: This card reversed is all about blocked intuition or secrets kept. It suggests denial, confusion, or ignoring your instincts. Where are you second-guessing yourself? Clear the noise—limit outside opinions and trust what you already know.

name: The Empress
upright: This card is all about creativity, abundance, and nurturing energy. Upright, it suggests growth, fertility, or enjoying life’s pleasures. Where in your life do you need to give yourself more care or creative freedom? Do one thing today that feeds your body or your imagination.
reversed: This card reversed is all about neglect, burnout, or blocked creativity. It suggests smothering energy or lack of self-care. Are you giving too much without refilling your own cup? Step back, rest, and create space for inspiration to flow back in.

name: The Emperor
upright: This card is all about structure, authority, and discipline. Upright, it suggests stability, clear rules, and leadership. Reflection: Where would boundaries or structure make your life easier right now? Action: Commit to one system or boundary that keeps you grounded.
reversed: This card reversed is all about control gone too far or lack of order. It suggests rigidity, power struggles, or chaos. Reflection: Where are you clinging too tightly—or not stepping up at all? Action: Loosen your grip where you’re being too rigid, or take responsibility where you’ve been passive.

name: Ace of Wands
upright: This card is all about fresh inspiration and creative sparks. Upright, it suggests new beginnings, motivation, or raw energy. Reflection: What excites you right now? Action: Say yes to one new idea and explore it.
reversed: This card reversed is all about delays or blocked inspiration. It suggests false starts, wasted energy, or hesitation. Reflection: Where are you second-guessing your fire? Action: Reignite by taking one small, passionate step forward.

name: Two of Wands
upright: This card is all about planning and looking forward. Upright, it suggests choices, new horizons, or future growth. Reflection: What path feels most expansive for you? Action: Make a plan and take the first step toward it.
reversed: This card reversed is all about fear of the unknown or poor planning. It suggests hesitation, delays, or shrinking from possibility. Reflection: Where are you playing small instead of stepping out? Action: Expand your vision, even if it scares you.

name: Three of Wands

reversed: This card reversed is all about delays or lack of foresight. It suggests missed opportunities, obstacles, or short-sightedness. Reflection: Where are you limiting your own horizon? Action: Open up and think bigger.

name: Four of Wands

reversed: This card reversed is all about instability or lack of harmony. It suggests tension, unfinished projects, or feeling unwelcome. Reflection: Where is your foundation shaky? Action: Strengthen your support system.

name: Five of Wands

reversed: This card reversed is all about avoidance or inner conflict. It suggests resolution, compromise, or suppressed tension. Reflection: Where are you avoiding a fight that needs airing out? Action: Face conflict directly but calmly.

name: Six of Wands

reversed: This card reversed is all about pride or lack of recognition. It suggests self-doubt, failure, or arrogance. Reflection: Where are you depending too much on others’ approval? Action: Celebrate your wins privately if needed.

name: Seven of Wands

reversed: This card reversed is all about overwhelm or giving up. It suggests exhaustion, lack of confidence, or feeling under attack. Reflection: Where are you burning out by always being on guard? Action: Step back and pick your battles.
